property_summary: For any contract balance d and any call value v (including v = 0, and including calls whose value differs from the held balance), a successful withdraw() must transfer the contract's ENTIRE balance (d + v) to the Owner, leaving address(c).balance == 0; the mutant sends only msg.value, so with v = 0 and d > 0 it succeeds while leaving d locked in the contract. (The InvMutTest adds a payable receive() so the Owner can actually accept the transfer — the key to making the reference's full-balance transfer succeed.)
change_summary: Send only msg.value instead of the full contract balance in withdraw().
